name: Rotate Garry's Mod TrueNAS VMs - 4 of 6 strict gated

parameters.content:
## TrueNAS Garry's Mod VM rotation - strict status gated

Every hour:
1. Build a random 4-of-6 rotation from VM IDs 50, 51, 52, 54, 55, and 56.
2. Check all six VM states and stop only those that report RUNNING.
3. Wait each selected VM's independent random 0-15 minute offset.
4. Immediately before each start, check status again.
5. Start only if the fresh state is STOPPED.
6. If the VM is still RUNNING, send another stop, wait 60 seconds, re-check, and only start if it is now STOPPED.

This avoids TrueNAS 422 errors like: 'already running' and 'state is currently not RUNNING'.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const pick = (v) => { if (v == null) return ''; if (typeof v === 'string') { const s = v.trim(); try { return pick(JSON.parse(s)); } catch (e) { const m = s.match(/"state"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/i); if (m) return m[1]; if (/^(RUNNING|STOPPED|SUSPENDED|PAUSED)$/i.test(s)) return s; return ''; } } if (typeof v === 'object') { return v.state || v.status || pick(v.result) || pick(v.body) || pick(v.data) || pick(v.response) || ''; } return ''; }; return String(pick($json)).toUpperCase(); })() }}
